issues.description: Method return-type mismatch for Milkable.messageOnMilk(): the problem statement and UML specify Milkable.messageOnMilk() returns a String (used like System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk()) and described to return the text "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). In the solution repository, Milkable.messageOnMilk() is declared to return boolean and Goat/Seal implement it by printing the message and returning true. This inconsistency between the specified String return type and the solution's boolean return type will confuse students and break code/tests that expect a String return value.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API and implementations consistent with the problem statement: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String, and update Goat and Seal to return the milk message string (e.g. "Goat Buttinsky is milked" / "Seal Clarabelle is milked") instead of printing and returning boolean. Update any call sites (e.g., Main) to print the returned String. Alternatively, if the intended design is to return boolean, update the problem statement/UML and example usage in Main to reflect a boolean return and document that implementations perform printing; however, aligning the solution to the stated String return is the preferred fix to match the UML and instructions.
